chunks: Everything in this book that is from Ma‘rūf ibn Kharrabūdh, I have transmitted it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Sa‘d ibn ‘Abd Allah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Malik ibn ‘Atiyyah al-Ahmasi, from Ma‘rūf ibn Kharrabūdh al-Makki.

key_terms.أَبِي: My father; the immediate source named by the compiler in this chain.
key_terms.الْمَكِّيِّ: Al-Makki; identifying Ma‘rūf ibn Kharrabūdh as being associated with Makkah.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates direct attribution of the report through a stated chain.
key_terms.مَعْرُوفِ بْنِ خَرَّبُوذٍ: Ma‘rūf ibn Kharrabūdh, the transmitter to whom this chain leads.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Ma‘rūf ibn Kharrabūdh in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Ma‘rūf ibn Kharrabūdh in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission and preserving the scholarly basis for tracing hadith back through named transmitters.
